# Acoustic guitar samples

Source recordings: **University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios**.
Collection and editing: **N. P. Brosowsky**, tonejs-instruments.
The upstream collection distributes its samples under
[Creative Commons Attribution 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode

Source: https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments/tree/622c2f1c32c8cfce4158ddc3eb26e518ddef37e5/samples/guitar-acoustic

See UPSTREAM-README.md and UPSTREAM-sample-source-info.txt for the original
license declaration and source inventory. Thirteen MP3 files are copied without
changing their bytes and base64 wrapped in acoustic-bank.js. The manifest records
their checksums. The player repitches nearby recorded notes and applies gain and
release envelopes. No Tone.js loader/runtime is included. No author endorsement
is implied. These recordings retain their separate license and are excluded from
SOUND CRUISE's proprietary scope. Keep this notice with the bank.

Runtime loads the bank from the same local origin. This candidate does not add
the recordings to the public package allowlist.
